title: The Extension Fee on an Equipment Rental and Demo Agreement That Has Already Carried a Change-of-Model Fee
content:
An Equipment Rental and Demo agreement that has already been charged for a change of model has already paid the shop for handling it once, and what is raised on top of the extra days follows that.

## The rule

Where the rental account carries the shop's fee for a change of model against the agreement, and the agreement was written for at least the package's multi-day threshold in days, no extension fee is raised at all.

Where the rental account carries that fee and the agreement was written for fewer days than the package's multi-day threshold, half the package's extension fee is raised.

In any other case nothing under this heading changes the extension fee.

## The package figures this rule reads

| Package | Multi-day threshold, days | Extension fee | Half of it |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Junior Ski & Board Rental | 3 | 10.00 USD | 5.00 USD |
| Basic Ski & Board Rental | 3 | 10.00 USD | 5.00 USD |
| Sport Ski & Board Rental | 3 | 12.00 USD | 6.00 USD |
| Performance Ski & Board Rental | 3 | 18.00 USD | 9.00 USD |
| Demo Ski & Board Rental | 2 | 25.00 USD | 12.50 USD |
| Season-Long Lease Package | 1 | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD |

Half the fee is rounded half up to two decimal places.

## The two conditions in combination

| A change-of-model fee on the rental account | Days the agreement was written for | Extension fee raised |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | at least the package's threshold | none at all |
| yes | fewer than the package's threshold | half the package's extension fee |
| no | either way | nothing under this heading changes it |

A length exactly equal to the package's threshold is at least that threshold, and takes the first row.

## Worked figures on hypothetical agreements

- A Sport Ski & Board Rental agreement written for 5 days whose account carries a change-of-model fee: 5 days is at least the threshold of 3, so no extension fee is raised at all.
- A Sport Ski & Board Rental agreement written for 2 days whose account carries a change-of-model fee: 2 days is fewer than 3, so 6.00 USD is raised, half of the package's 12.00 USD.
- A Sport Ski & Board Rental agreement whose account carries no change-of-model fee: nothing under this heading changes the extension fee.

## Point of judgement

**Which day count is read.** The days the agreement was written for, not the extra days asked for.
